So, you asked about last week. Honestly? It was a strange trip. The flight was fine, only two hours, but the airport was terrible. It was six in the morning and it was already crowded, and my bag was the last one on the belt, of course. The hotel was a surprise. It was small, but it was very comfortable, and the people there were wonderful. The city was beautiful. The streets were full of people until midnight, every night. And the food. The food was the best part of the whole week. I was there for five days and I was never in the same restaurant twice. Was it a good trip? Yes. Was it restful? No. But I was lucky with the weather, and that changes everything.

Everybody asks me about that trip, so here it is. The flight was at eleven at night and it was four hours late. Four hours. I was at the gate from nine until three in the morning, and the coffee there was terrible. When I arrived, the taxi was expensive, the traffic was slow, and the hotel was full. My room was not ready, so I was in the lobby with my luggage for two hours. And then, at nine in the morning, a man from the hotel came to me with a coffee and a key and he said: your room is ready, and breakfast is free today. And you know what? It was a good week. The city was beautiful, the people were kind, and today I only remember the good part. That is the thing about a bad start. It is only a bad start.
